_purpose: Public-school approval cards. They do not decide route; they make GREEN review clearer.

templates.title: Approve release to parent / guardian
templates.risk_reason: The Markdown draft is already available for internal review. This separate action would release it outside the school workspace.
templates.decision_prompt: Approve only if the content, recipient, channel and verified facts are correct. Demo mode simulates the release.

templates.title: Approve student-record change
templates.risk_reason: Would change a sensitive official student record (e.g. attendance/discipline); the applicable legal and school-policy basis must be verified.
templates.decision_prompt: Approve only if the change is intended, authorised, and the student is correctly identified.
